A quick dash dodge.

skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward melee attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Moving Mountains and Seas
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Intimidating Presence
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ride the Momentum
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up

Perform a melee attack on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Special Attack: Sonic Pressure-Point Strike
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Touch of Death
skills.desc: With Break Force, press to activate:

skills.name: Special Attack: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Physical DMG.
skills.desc:
The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Special Attack: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force.
When Pan Yinhu is the active character, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 40% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active character, he becomes Invulnerable.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike
skills.desc: With enough Energy, press  to activate:

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Physical DMG.
skills.desc:
Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
Agents who enter the field via this Quick Assist will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Core Passive. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Special Attack: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Anointed with Wok Steam
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies on the way.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Physical DMG and healing all squad members for X HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on all squad members, recovering Y% HP/s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment
skills.desc: For a brief period when Pan Yinhu's EX Special Attack: Mountainous Pulse Strike hits an enemy and triggers Quick Assist, the next Agent entering through a Quick Assist or Chain Attack will gain the Meridian Flow effect. This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to X% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Iron Stomach
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing all DMG against the target by 20%. Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect can't stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

cons.name: Qi Shield
cons.desc: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.

cons.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
cons.desc: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

cons.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: First-Class Head Chef
cons.desc: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect cannot stack.

cons.name: "Thiren"
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Meridian Theory
cons.desc: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
